row.body: The platform, every seed and every tenant serve the same surfaces and declare each statement once as sentence, page and endpoint in the shared seed/worker/src/contract.js; foundation/fleetcontract.py reads every live system daily and as the failure-audit detector fleet-contract. Tests pass: seed/worker/test/contract.test.js, site/contract.test.mjs, tests/foundation/test_fleetcontract.py. Source: Rowan 2026-11-25.
